title: Al-Inshiqaq 84:16-20 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Inshiqaq and the sifat of strength
source: Written for quran/y6 lesson 14 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Inshiqaq 84:16-20 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 14. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ (١٦) وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ (١٧) وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ (١٨) لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍۢ (١٩) فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ (٢٠)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: So I swear by the twilight glow
And [by] the night and what it envelops
And [by] the moon when it becomes full
[That] you will surely experience state after state.
So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,

keywords.def: the redness in the sky after sunset

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Inshiqaq 84:16-20 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 84:16-20 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 84:16-20 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Write the three things Allah swears by in 84:16 to 18.
questions.a: The twilight (shafaq), the night and what it gathers, and the moon when it becomes full.
All 20 ayat in order with no more than two prompts.

options: The stages of a person's life and the Hereafter
questions.a: A) The stages of a person's life and the Hereafter. The ayah is about people passing from one state to another; the moon in 84:18 is a picture of change.

questions.q: Think again: The twilight, the night and the full moon change step by step. 84:19 says people also pass from stage to stage. What stages will you pass through?
questions.a: Childhood, youth, old age, death and the Hereafter: 'You will surely embark upon stage after stage' (84:19).
